description: Prepare a precise, source-linked change to one legal practice-profile setting without repeating the full bootstrap interview.

provenance.author: LiNKskills adaptation
provenance.source: Nine domain-specific practice lifecycle source variants; originals/notices in references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
provenance.license: Exact per-source licenses preserved; Carlos handles licensing.

routing.when_to_use: Use when the founder asks to change one existing legal profile section, practice position, escalation setting or output preference.
when_not_to_use: Substantive legal work assigned to domain-specific task
Assuming a profile is canon without founder review
Unsupported profile write or integration probe
exclusion_rules: No assumed operating model or jurisdiction
ambiguity_rules: Read known evidence; ask founder only material missing facts

forbidden_actions: Invented company facts, position, jurisdiction, law or integration availability
Unapproved profile write, external contact, or plugin command
Local runtime sidecar or custom configuration store
verification_steps: Read authorized current profile and source records first.
Use matching domain card and preserve source differences.
Validate before/after or profile-draft contract; disclose conflicts and unknowns.
Use native approved interface only; otherwise report exact gap.
completion_criteria: Task-specific profile artifact or precise blocking gap returned
No unapproved profile or external mutation
known_limitations: Draft, uncertified, and no native profile write path claimed
Current legal operating model remains unknown until founder-confirmed
